versions.what: every OpenGrand image before 2026-11-16 fold step 2 (diagnostic caves, ota_loader*, ota_core*, ota_base*, ota_hookdemo*, ota_power*, ota_main up to 1ec47025 = ota_main_20): feature bits only

ota_main from 2026-11-16 fold step 2: everything ota_main 1ec47025 had (feat0 0x3B, feat1 0x77, feat2 0x7F, feat3 0x3F with R2 / intake gate / R3 folded in) + the fn 0x24 file transfer fixes (read past 129 packets, write past 2681 B, Cancel answered)

ota_main from 2026-11-21 fold step 3: everything of version 2, with S3 read owner, S4 write owner, the MIDI channel judge and the executor gate always on - their off / on ops 1B 05 04 <x>, 1B 05 06 <x>, 1B 07 <x>, 1F 01 <x> answer rc 1 (the records 1B 05 05, 1B 05 07, 1B 07, 1F 00 stay)

ota_main from 2026-11-21 (T1 canary): everything of version 3 + the RAM canary op 0x20 over the unreferenced SDRAM blocks T1-A / T1-B / T1-C / T1-D / T1-E / T2 (arm from a bound controller, bounded fill / verify per engine-loop pass, read, disarm)

features.name: nordump
features.what: NOR dump to USB (diagnostic image phase2b only)

features.name: ota
features.what: slot payload of an ota_loader, ops 0x10-0x16

features.name: tvwake
features.what: TV wake (policy flag bit 2, wake cause 5)

features.name: readowner
features.what: S3 read owner, record op 1B 05 05 (on at boot; from ngver 3 always on, no off op)

features.name: execgate
features.what: executor gate, record op 1F 00 (on at boot; from ngver 3 always on, no off op)

features.name: midichan
features.what: MIDI channel / delayed apply, record op 1B 07 (on at boot with the ota_loader_v3+ sites; from ngver 3 no off op)

features.name: writeowner
features.what: S4 write owner, record op 1B 05 07 (on at boot; from ngver 3 always on, no off op)

features.name: filexfer
features.what: fn 0x24 file transfer fixes: read past 129 DataPackets, write past 2681 B, Cancel answered at once (also in ota_main_20 = ngver 1, where the app cannot tell)

features.name: standbyfanout
features.what: standby / wake notice 59 7F reaches every core-bound controller even while the panel holds the stock binding - the app needs no 19 00 poll

features.name: ramcanary
features.what: RAM canary op 0x20: arm (bound controller) / status / region record / disarm over eight unreferenced SDRAM blocks, nothing written before an arm
